rows.text: There was a small wooden box on the table.
Her grandfather Ben sat by the window.
A brass latch kept it shut.
A flag at the window hung still.
Mara wanted to open the box.
The flag swung and hung still again.
Mara was delighted with the flag.
Then she pushed the flag hard again.
The flag swung and hung still again.
A spring inside the box uncoiled.
A toy flew out and landed on the floor.
She was curious about the flag.
There was an old cupboard in the attic.
A brass bolt kept it shut.
Mara wanted to open the cupboard.
She wondered what the flag did.
The flag swung and hung still again.
The flag swung and hung still again.
Mara remembered how Ben had opened the box.
Mara was delighted with the bolt.
Mara grew frustrated with the door.
The bolt snapped back into place.
But this time the door sprang open.
Mara realized that the bolt had kept the door shut.
